subject: Account Suspended
body: Your account has been suspended. Verify your identity immediately to restore access.

subject: Payment Failed
body: We could not process your latest payment. Update your billing information now to avoid interruption.

subject: Password Expiration Notice
body: Your Microsoft 365 password expires today. Confirm your current password to keep access.

subject: Tax Refund Available
body: You are eligible for a tax refund. Submit your banking information to receive your payment.

subject: Unusual Order Detected
body: An unusual purchase was made using your account. Sign in immediately if you did not authorize it.

subject: Apple ID Locked
body: Your Apple ID has been temporarily locked due to unusual activity. Unlock your account below.

subject: Payroll Information Required
body: Payroll processing failed. Confirm your direct deposit account details before 5 PM today.

subject: Package Delivery Failed
body: We attempted delivery but could not complete it. Pay the small redelivery fee to reschedule.

subject: Fraud Alert
body: Suspicious activity was detected on your bank account. Verify your account number and PIN immediately.

subject: Immediate Job Offer
body: You have been selected for a remote position. Complete the attached hiring form and provide your SSN.

subject: Required Password Reset
body: IT detected a security issue with your account. Use the link below to reset your password immediately.

subject: Document Awaiting Signature
body: A confidential document is waiting for your signature. Sign in with your work credentials to view it.

subject: Payment Received
body: You received a payment of $450. Log in to confirm the transaction and release the funds.

subject: Shared File Expiring
body: A file shared with you will expire today. Sign in to your Dropbox account to keep access.

subject: Urgent Request
body: I am in a meeting and need you to purchase gift cards immediately. Reply with the card numbers when complete.

subject: New Sign-In Detected
body: We detected a new sign-in from an unknown device. Confirm whether this was you.

subject: Overdue Invoice
body: Your invoice is overdue. Open the invoice portal and submit payment today to avoid additional fees.

subject: Mailbox Storage Full
body: Your university mailbox has reached its storage limit. Log in to increase your storage capacity.

subject: You Won a $500 Gift Card
body: Congratulations! You were selected to receive a $500 gift card. Claim your reward before it expires.

subject: VPN Access Will Be Disabled
body: Your remote access will be disabled unless you verify your employee credentials today.

subject: Final Project Reminder
body: Reminder that the final project is due Friday. Please submit your notebook and documentation through Canvas.

subject: Benefits Enrollment Opens Monday
body: Open enrollment begins Monday. Review the benefits guide on the employee portal before making your selections.

subject: Your Order Has Shipped
body: Your recent order has shipped and is expected to arrive Thursday. You can view tracking details in your account.

subject: Repository Activity
body: A pull request was opened in a repository you follow. Visit GitHub to review the changes.

subject: Team Meeting Tomorrow
body: Our weekly team meeting is tomorrow at 10 AM. We will review project progress and next week's priorities.

subject: Library Book Due Soon
body: The book checked out to your account is due next week. Renew it online if you need additional time.

subject: Your Spotify Receipt
body: Thanks for your monthly subscription payment. Your receipt is available in your account history.

subject: Quarterly Security Training
body: Quarterly security awareness training is now available. Complete the assigned course through the employee learning portal.

subject: Updated Project Notes
body: I added the changes we discussed to the project notes. Let me know if anything needs to be revised.

subject: Spring Registration Information
body: Registration appointments for the spring semester are now available in the student portal.

subject: Folder Shared With You
body: Jordan shared the Project Files folder with you. You can view it from your Dropbox account.

subject: New Connection Request
body: You have a new connection request. Sign in to LinkedIn to view the request.

subject: Password Policy Reminder
body: Your password will expire in 14 days. Change it through the company portal when convenient. IT will never ask you to send your password by email.

subject: Monthly Statement Available
body: Your monthly account statement is ready. Access it securely through online banking or the mobile application.

subject: Meeting Invitation Updated
body: The project review meeting has moved from 2 PM to 3 PM Thursday. The calendar invitation has been updated.

subject: Adobe Subscription Receipt
body: Your subscription renewed successfully. You can review your invoice from your Adobe account.

subject: Advising Appointment
body: This is confirmation of your advising appointment next Tuesday at 1:30 PM. Reply if you need to reschedule.

subject: Weekly Security Newsletter
body: This week's newsletter covers phishing awareness, password security, and recent cybersecurity research.

subject: Direct Deposit Confirmation
body: Your direct deposit information was updated through the employee portal. If you did not make this change, contact payroll using the internal directory.

subject: Microsoft Account Security Tips
body: Review recommended steps for protecting your Microsoft account, including multifactor authentication and password security.
